plan: To maximize profit, bid just below my value to outbid others while ensuring a positive outcome. The worst-case scenario is winning and paying close to my value, minimizing profit. Bid slightly above the midpoint of the value range to increase winning chances while maintaining profitability. A bid of $25 offers a balance between competitiveness and profit, assuming other bidders bid near their value. This strategy accounts for the worst-case scenario where the second-highest bid is just below mine, ensuring a positive net gain if I win.
